title: MCP Response Envelope
description: Standardized response structure for all MCP actions.

action.description: The name of the action performed.

data.description: The result payload of the action, defined by action-specific schemas.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 formatted timestamp of the response.

execution_time_ms.description: Duration of action execution in milliseconds.

authenticated.description: Indicates whether the current session is authenticated.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for the request-response cycle.

protocol_version.description: Version of the MCP protocol supported.
